thread:
Priya: Quick sync  vendors reported staggered ETA shifts for Gaudi (APAC) and MI300 (EU). Can we agree a single low-friction handshake so marketplace flips + partner press don't conflict?
Mateo: TL;DR: H100/H200/B200 nominal. MI300 EU needs a small perf patch (~3d). Gaudi APAC kernel fix slipped ~10d.
Suki: Product: we must avoid showing "global" availability when regions differ. Suggest three marketplace states per SKU: "coming-soon, limited, available".
Priya: Ops: propose auto marketplace flip to "limited" after SI.cert == true + 48h canary green. "available" requires Comms press-go + partner_ack.
Mateo: SI will emit webhook /si/certs with fields: sku, region, cert_ts, pass_rate, cert_id, blocking_notes. We'll include suggested_stability_window.
DevOpsBot: Ticket PART-7202 created to allocate canary pools: APAC 2x GPUs, EU 1x GPU. Assigned @infra-oncall.
Comms: Press rule: no partner quotes published until press-go is set. We'll collect partner_ack records (partner, sku, region, quote_confirmed) before flipping press-go.
Suki: Runtime: enable announce_canary tag during canary and add auto-fallback rule: if latency > SLO+15% for 5m -> route to quantized B200 variant and set header X-Fallback:quant. Telemetry event fallback.count.
Priya: Circuit-breaker idea: if error_rate > 1.5% OR model-quality regression >1% during canary -> auto-rollback to "limited" and notify partners. Keep a 10m rolling window.
Mateo: SI note: we'll publish a pass_rate value; recommend auto-flip threshold pass_rate >= 95%. If pass_rate between 80-95% we hold and extend canary.
VendorPM: I'll coordinate partner_ack and ask partners for embargo confirmation. Also request partners avoid saying "available worldwide" until press-go.
Comms: I'll draft two embargo templates: "region-limited" and "wave-release" and circulate today. Legal wants explicit region clause.
Priya: Action items recap:
- Mateo -> publish cert webhook + pass_rate + suggested_stability_window (EOD)
- DevOpsBot/@infra-oncall -> PART-7202 canary pool allocation (now)
- Suki/Runtime -> implement canary tag + fallback routing + telemetry (2d)
- Comms -> embargo templates + partner_ack process (EOD)
- VendorPM -> collect partner_ack and confirm no external comms before press-go (tomorrow)

Mateo: If Gaudi patch misses ETA, recommend APAC stays canary-only and NA/EU proceed as scheduled. We'll post updates here.
Suki: We'll add a Console banner: "Regional availability subject to SI certification. Press announcements gated."
DevOpsBot: PART-7202 updated: infra-oncall accepted.
Priya: Thanks team. If partners publish early, escalate to me and Comms immediately. Otherwise we'll proceed with staged waves and a single press-go handshake per wave.
